findings.title: Thirteen lessons do not provide a complete Vietnamese version
findings.evidence: The VI fields retain generic English task templates such as '[predict] Predict the next state or event before it is revealed'. Sixteen exam-cues/knowledge blocks are byte-for-byte identical between VI and EN in queue, linked-list, dictionary, hashing and the four OOP lessons.
findings.required_correction: Author actual Vietnamese instructional copy for every affected block while preserving IDs, pattern data and official English literals. Re-run a semantic parity review; nonempty-field checks are insufficient.

findings.title: Worked examples do not implement the Stage 0 worked-example chain
findings.evidence: Every worked-example is serialized as one prose string. The registry exposes no learner-usable requirement, design, verified Python, trace, output/test and evidence sequence; 0/26 contains a fenced Python example. Concise examples such as data-models and binary-search narrate a state change but do not provide executable Python plus test evidence.
findings.required_correction: Add a worked-example artifact or structured block payload for each lesson with the applicable requirement, design, Python, trace, expected output/tests and evidence refs. Render the sequence as distinguishable learner steps and independently check code/trace/output identity.

findings.title: Practice and retrieval are prompts without assessable feedback or rubric
findings.evidence: All practice and retrieval payloads are scalar prose. No practice block names an explicit rubric or feedback path. The thirteen legacy-composition lessons repeat generic predict/complete/transfer and explain/reconstruct templates, often changing only the pattern label. The other lessons describe guided/faded/independent activities but do not carry a concrete learner artifact, expected evidence, hint/reveal sequence and repair feedback.
findings.required_correction: Supply concrete guided, faded and independent items with stable IDs, input/fixture, expected learner artifact, hints, reveal condition, misconception diagnosis, feedback/repair and rubric. Add retrieval items that hide the answer and require reconstruction or trace repair, then render and test the reveal flow.

findings.title: Two zero-pattern lessons promise runtime interactions that the fallback cannot provide
findings.evidence: Both lessons have no pattern IDs and mode conceptual-no-runtime-pattern. Testing instructs learners to use Previous and Reset. Dictionary instructs learners to predict the next HASH_SETUP event, although no Stage 8 pattern is joined. The other four zero-pattern lessons explicitly describe a conceptual diagram/table trace.
findings.required_correction: Either connect an existing verified Stage 8 pattern without inventing a new pattern, or rewrite and render these blocks as an honest conceptual diagram/table/self-check with controls that actually exist.

findings.title: Thirteen mark-protection blocks lack an explicit mark or authored-rubric join
findings.evidence: The marking-pitfalls blocks for these lessons have no QP or MS authority and do not expose an authored rubric item. They provide useful warnings, but the learner cannot follow the required requirement/mark-or-rubric/method/error/check-repair chain.
findings.required_correction: Join each applicable warning to a verified QP/MS marking atom, or label and link an AlgoCore-authored rubric when official marking does not exist. Preserve the method step, error, detection and repair relationship in the rendered block.
